name: webvoyager-readonly-15-remaining
selection_rule: Read-only information-seeking tasks across eight sites. No cart, booking, login, upload, or purchase actions. Each task is manually graded against the page state observed on the run date.
notes: Not leaderboard-compatible: the upstream WebVoyager protocol allows writes and uses an LLM judge.
Live pages change; re-check snapshot tasks before each run.
A run that finishes with blocked or no_suitable_product is not automatically a failure.
selection_note: Complement of the clean-site pilot: GitHub, Coursera, Allrecipes, the remaining Wolfram tasks, and arXiv--10. These are reported separately because preflight found CDN degradation or content blocking on several sites.

tasks.question: Give a constraint on the set of inequalities for the inner region of the pentagram.
tasks.rubric: Gives a constraint or system describing the inner region of a pentagram; the answer must be a mathematical result, not a page summary.

tasks.question: Pack 24 circles in a circle radius r. Compare Densest known packing and Square packing. Then tell me the radius of the inner circles.
tasks.rubric: Reports the inner-circle radius for 24 circles packed in a circle, and distinguishes the densest-known and square packings.

tasks.question: Show the solution of y"(z) + sin(y(z)) = 0 from wolframalpha.
tasks.rubric: Gives the solution to the stated ODE, including the independent variable and any constants Wolfram Alpha reports.

tasks.question: Show the electrical resistivity of UNS A92024 and UNS G10800 at 20 degrees Celsius.
tasks.rubric: Reports the electrical resistivity of both UNS A92024 and UNS G10800 at 20 C, with units.

tasks.question: Find out how much more package storage the Enterprise version has over Team in GitHub Pricing.
tasks.rubric: Reports how much more package storage Enterprise has than Team on the GitHub pricing page, in the units shown.

tasks.question: Look up the latest stable release version of Vuex and find out when it was published.
tasks.rubric: Names the latest stable Vuex release and its publication date from the GitHub releases page.

tasks.question: If I start using Copilot Individual, how much US dollars will it cost per year and what features does it have?
tasks.rubric: Reports the annual USD price and at least two listed features of Copilot Individual from GitHub pricing.

tasks.question: Find the official GitHub repository for ALBERT and show me what files the repo changed in the most recent commit.
tasks.rubric: Names files changed in the most recent commit of the official ALBERT repository; the commit must be read from the repository page.

tasks.question: Visit ArXiv Help on how to withdraw an article if the submission is not yet announced.
tasks.rubric: Reports the help instructions for withdrawing an article that has not yet been announced.

tasks.question: Find a popular recipe for a chocolate chip cookie and list the ingredients and preparation steps.
tasks.rubric: Lists the ingredients and preparation steps for a popular chocolate-chip cookie recipe on Allrecipes.

tasks.question: Find a high-rated recipe for vegetarian lasagna, list the key ingredients required, and include the total preparation and cook time stated on the recipe.
tasks.rubric: Lists key ingredients and the stated prep and cook times for a high-rated vegetarian lasagna recipe.

tasks.question: Find a recipe with over 100 reviews for Fried Fish on Allrecipes, list the Full Nutrition Label and tell me the amount of Iron per Serving.
tasks.rubric: Reports the iron per serving from the full nutrition label of a Fried Fish recipe with over 100 reviews.

tasks.question: Find a Beginner's Spanish Specialization on Coursera and show all the courses in this Specialization.
tasks.rubric: Names the Beginner Spanish Specialization and lists its courses from the Coursera page.

tasks.question: Identify a Specialization on Coursera that teaches C++ programming for beginners, provide the name and what the learning outcomes are.
tasks.rubric: Names a beginner C++ Specialization and reports the learning outcomes listed on its page.

tasks.question: Search for a Specialization on Coursera about project management that is produced by a university, show a testimonial for this Specialization.
tasks.rubric: Names a university-produced project-management Specialization and quotes one testimonial shown on the page.
